Release sweep 2026-11-21 — raw logs and checks

Every release from v0.0.1 to v0.2.4 (15 releases), measured under identical conditions on a dedicated lab VM (Google Cloud c4-highmem-8, Ubuntu 26.10 — the production x86 origin's machine type). No production host was loaded: server and load generator both ran inside the VM, over its loopback, server pinned to cores 0-3 (--workers 4), h2load to cores 4-7. Each release was PGO-built from its tag with one unified gather profile (Rust 1.99.1) and served with uniform production flags. Three rounds per build in rotated order; tables show medians. Per-round data: release-sweep-2026-11-21.tsv · Three-way vs nginx: lab-threeway-2026-11-21.tsv · Functional checks (15/15 pass): lab-checks-2026-11-21.tsv · Perf counters: lab-perf-2026-11-21.tsv.
